## Highlights

- Find failed or skipped website pages directly from the crawl summary. The page list now has
  All, Failed and Skipped filters with counts and separate pagination, so investigating an
  incomplete crawl no longer requires paging through successful results. [#4065](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4065)
- Task notifications now follow current project access. Someone removed from a restricted
  project stops receiving new task details, and queued email checks access again before sending.
  Existing notification history and subscriptions are retained; notifications resume if access
  is restored. [#4056](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4056)

## Upgrade notes

- The changes from v0.5.68 add no database migration or environment variable. Follow the
  [self-hosted upgrade guide](https://docs.tale.dev/self-hosted/operate/upgrades) for your deployment.
- REST integrations can filter website pages with `state=failed` or `state=skipped`. Keep the
  same filter when following a pagination cursor; a cursor from another filter is refused.
  [API reference](https://docs.tale.dev/develop/api-reference)
